verdict.rationale: Bugbot responds to PR-comment commands: `cursor review` / `bugbot run` trigger a review, and `verbose=true` makes it reply with the rules and logs used. It also reads existing top-level and inline PR comments as context to build on prior feedback. However, nothing in the evidence shows it answering free-form questions or giving follow-up explanations when a developer replies in a thread. Missing for 10: conversational replies to developer questions in the PR thread, threaded follow-up explanations on its own findings, natural-language commands beyond fixed trigger keywords, and independent hands-on corroboration of in-thread interaction.
